Assembly / mating notes: Deans/T-plug mating pigtail to actual battery. Solder: 1 battery positive, 2 GND. No PCB header added.
Cable mate: XHP-4 + SXH-001T-P0.6 (22–28 AWG). Pins 1 +5V, 2 GND, 3 CUT_PWM, 4 VBAT_SENSE. Check remote main-PCB pinout.
Cable mate: PHR-3 + SPH-002T-P0.5S (24–30 AWG). 1 adapter +7.2V, 2 GND, 3 servo D. Split to green power input and servo-port D only. Separate ESP UART TX/RX/GND cable required.
Cable mate: XT30U-F. Insulated shorting loop between contacts makes cutter ARM link. Neither J4 contact is a normal GND output.
Cable mate: XT30U-F. 1 HEATER_PLUS, 2 HEATER_LOW, to nichrome terminals.
Cable mate: XHP-2 + SXH-001T-P0.6 (22–28 AWG). 1 +5V, 2 GND. Check remote camera-PCB pinout.
Cable mate: 0436450300 + 0430300007 contacts (20–24 AWG). 1 GND, 2 fused +7.2V, 3 serial D. Factory C044 end is 5264-3P; see TSAT-3B-PDB-Wiring.md for compatible wire sizes and adapter options.
Solder leads to external brake resistor bank: 1 VSERVO_7V2, 2 BRAKE_DRAIN (not GND). No cable housing needed.
Cable mate: existing 2.54 mm two-position jumper, or SPC02SYAN. Main input ON gate-bias link, not the cutter arming plug.
